text: Election of the Vice-Chair of the Toronto Preservation Board in accordance with Municipal Code Chapter 27, Council Procedures By-law, Appendix A-2, effective August 26, 2019 for a term consistent with Council and until a successor is appointed.

The Toronto Preservation Board: 1. Elected Paul Farrelly as Vice-Chair of the Toronto Preservation Board, effective August 26, 2019 for a term consistent with Council and until a successor is appointed.
